positive_evidence: Small-squad real-time tactics strongly match the profile's preference for difficult situations solved by choosing the right specialist and approach.
Hazardous behind-enemy-lines missions give each tactical problem a concrete objective and strong historical-action identity.
negative_evidence: Stealth can become frustrating if success requires excessive trial-and-error study before the intended tactical options are readable.

positive_evidence: Combining commandos with different expertise creates layered tactical problem solving and strong learnable mastery.
Mission-based objectives deep in enemy territory provide clear direction and changing operational contexts.
negative_evidence: Some stealth scenarios can demand repeated setup and route learning, which becomes a profile risk when feedback is unclear.

positive_evidence: A very large variety of units, spells and god archetypes creates exceptional strategic experimentation and mastery depth.
The aspiration to godhood gives the deep turn-based conquest a strong fantasy identity and explicit long-term objective.
negative_evidence: The enormous system depth can impose substantial pre-study and cognitive overhead before decisions become comfortable, a known friction point in the profile.

positive_evidence: Searching for truth beyond a food-inspection booth gives repetitive work a clear mystery and narrative purpose.
Choices in an unusual famine-state dystopia provide consequences and a distinctive authored setting rather than routine simulation alone.
negative_evidence: Inspection work can become mechanically repetitive if story changes do not regularly alter the meaning or rules of the task.

positive_evidence: Crafting equipment, taming creatures and building camps provide visible capability growth and several survival systems to master.
Being tiny in a giant hazardous world gives familiar survival mechanics a distinctive scale and traversal identity.
negative_evidence: A vast multiplayer survival world can become resource-heavy and weakly directed if discoveries do not keep changing goals.

positive_evidence: Skilled hack-and-slash combat and ability upgrades strongly match the user's preference for demanding, learnable mastery with tangible progression.
Cvstodia's nightmare religious imagery and the quest to break damnation provide an unusually strong artistic and narrative identity.
negative_evidence: Metroidvania navigation and repeated boss attempts can frustrate if routes or failure lessons are insufficiently clear.

positive_evidence: Fast-paced RTS conquest offers compact strategic decisions and quick feedback on tactical choices.
Its circle-based world structure gives the strategy a specific mechanical identity rather than generic map expansion.
negative_evidence: The candidate evidence provides limited proof of long-term progression or changing objectives beyond repeated conquest.

positive_evidence: Diving deeper, building habitats and crafting tools provide tangible development while traversal and survival systems reward learned mastery.
Investigating a deadly cover-up gives the alien ocean a clear mystery and narrative direction alongside strong environmental identity.
negative_evidence: Resource gathering and open exploration can temporarily become routine or leave the next objective unclear.

positive_evidence: Action-RPG combat, legendary crafting and base growth provide active mastery plus visible development across runs.
Procedural realms, giant creatures and the Ragnarök objective create changing encounters and a strong Norse identity for cooperative play.
negative_evidence: Repeated survival cycles can become routine if procedural changes do not meaningfully alter strategy or objectives.

positive_evidence: Strategic decisions, tactical combat and kingdom management create multiple interlocking mastery layers rather than one repetitive strategy loop.
Ancient magic, armies and empire building provide visible progression and a strong fantasy campaign identity.
negative_evidence: Kingdom upkeep may become routine if management expands faster than the variety of tactical situations.

positive_evidence: Crafting, mining and building provide tangible survival progression and several systems to develop over time.
Other crash survivors and a story-rich exploration frame give the island survival a human and narrative purpose beyond pure sandbox building.
negative_evidence: Resource gathering and an open world can become repetitive or weakly directed between major story developments.

positive_evidence: The candidate explicitly centers on an emotional journey, matching the profile's real interest in character relationships when narrative is strong.
A secluded summer island and rediscovery theme provide a coherent authored mood and clear personal arc.
negative_evidence: As a visual-novel-style narrative experience, it offers little intrinsic gameplay mastery and therefore depends heavily on writing and pacing.

positive_evidence: Class-defining colors, spellbooks and plot-twisting builds create substantial experimentation and mechanical mastery.
Influencing enemy growth makes progression interactive while the literary ink-and-books theme gives the roguelike a distinctive identity.
negative_evidence: Run-based structure may repeat early material if build variation does not keep encounters meaningfully fresh.

positive_evidence: Surviving against giant insects at tiny scale turns familiar backyard spaces into varied tactical exploration and combat problems.
The shrunken perspective provides a powerful identity hook while crafting and survival systems support tangible progression.
negative_evidence: Open-world gathering and base routines can become repetitive if exploration stops revealing meaningful new threats or goals.

positive_evidence: Determining the outcome of senior year through social choices directly supports the profile's interest in relationships and meaningful narrative consequences.
The old-style social-media interface gives the branching story a specific interactive identity rather than conventional dialogue presentation.
negative_evidence: There is little mechanical mastery, so the experience depends almost entirely on writing, characters and choice consequences.

positive_evidence: Beat-em-up combat rewards timing, crowd control and move mastery with immediate action feedback.
Handcrafted revival of a classic series, energetic music and over-the-top street fighting provide a strong stylistic identity.
negative_evidence: The genre's repeated enemy-clearing structure needs stage, character and encounter variety to avoid fatigue.

positive_evidence: Brawler combat, leveling and hundreds of equipment options combine execution mastery with broad tangible character progression.
Rebellious twins crossing worlds to save their foster father provide character stakes, clear direction and a strong story-action blend.
negative_evidence: Horde combat can become repetitive if weapon quantity does not translate into meaningfully different play styles.
